notes: New Omen editor (CEO-approved mockup): About | 1 Theme | 2 Size & screen | 3 Layout | 4 Customize, then Preferences and + Touch. Theme opens one picture per category, then that category’s themes (breadcrumbed), then a theme’s variants.…

Customize moved into the editor: a live copy of the portal (its own drawing and its own background layers) beside Portal (border, outer margin), Layers (the whole stack; the Base color layer has its opacity, its color is on Color), Color…
Text effects (Shadow; Reverse, with Black and white only and Stronger) now draw on Ganymede’s text. Metrics can color the gauges with Primary, Secondary or Accent.

God Mode: every editor tab can be saved as its theme’s default (Preferences, Touch, Size and Theme for every portal); Reset puts a tab back to it. The clock and Demo mode moved to Preferences; touch settings to the Touch tab.
